crossRefs.note: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

translations.web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
translations.bsb: Yet no one stretches out his hand against a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress.
translations.kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
translations.asv: Howbeit doth not one stretch out the hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
